samples.question: Starting at the ringed token, follow the one connected dark conveyor from start to finish. The token has four labeled states W, X, Y, and Z. At each station, apply its visible rule in path order: a clockwise arrow rotates the state one step W-X-Y-Z-W; a counterclockwise arrow rotates it one step backward; a fork keeps the state only if it is W or Y and otherwise advances it one step; a bar resets it to X. Which state label is on the token at the finish?
